summary: Implemented terminal window title support in Rich (uncommitted, tests not run per instructions). Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and allows (ControlType, str) control codes; rich/control.py maps it to the OSC 0 sequence ESC]0;title BEL and adds Control.title(title); rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool, which writes only when the console is a terminal; rich/_windows_renderer.py routes the control to LegacyWindowsTerm.set_title for legacy Windows consoles; tests/test_control.py adds test_set_window_title; CHANGELOG.md gets an Added entry. Titles are written unsanitized, so ESC or BEL characters in a title could terminate the sequence early; stripping them is a possible follow-up.
